rv.q: British drama doesn't get better than this.
My Night with Reg is the most artificial and the truest, the funniest and most searing play to be found anywhere on the London stage.
This is a first-rate revival of a first-rate play: an exceptional ensemble in a cannily plotted, adroitly painful story.
The whole proceeding seems to have moved further into silly comedy mode and away from the very thing which made it so important and captivating at the Donmar: its aching intensity and brutal honesty.

cn.t: Critics largely embrace this Donmar revival of Elyot's AIDS-era classic, praising its pitch-perfect blend of comedy and heartbreak. Most find the writing transcendent; one notes the West End transfer slightly softens its dramatic edge.
